video.agency.evidence: [树精卫士·codex] 代入树精，我应在敌人抵达前主动按地上甲。图1的0.75、1.00、1.25、1.50秒格中，无法确认木爪按进脚边泥土，也看不出藤甲从脚下生成并覆盖全身的明确变化；无法确认我已提前采取防御。2.00–6.25秒受攻击期间，我大多维持站立、手臂向前的姿态，4.50秒抬膝、5.50秒抬脚顶开的主动反应也无法辨明。6.50–7.50秒虽有挥击反击，但此前是否及时施防、受击回应仍拿不准，按要求判fail。；[食尸鬼·claude] Overall the behaviour fits what the ghoul wants: from 1.25–2.0s both ghouls sprint toward the treant and kick up dust. From 2.0–6.5s they stay at its lower legs and keep attacking. At 5.25–5.75s one is pushed back half a step and rushes straight back in by 6.0s, so it reacts to being hit. I'm unsure about the start. From 0.0s to 1.0s (the 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 and 1.0s cells) the two ghouls barely change position, staying about 160–220 px from the left edge of each cell. The spec says that from 0.5s they should keep charging straight from the opening pose without stopping, so they may be standing still while the treant crouches to cast. At 7.0s one ghoul looks like it is standing up straight, but at this thumbnail size I can't tell whether it is still trying to pounce. Because I can't confirm the 0.5–1.0s section, this is a fail.

video.gaze.evidence: [树精卫士·codex] 图1中我的头部较小且被苔叶遮挡。2.00–6.25秒格只能大致看出头朝前下方，不能确认持续盯住腿边敌人；规格6.5–7.7秒要求先盯住第一只、再转头看第二只，但6.50、6.75、7.00、7.25、7.50秒格未能辨明这次视线切换。9.75–12.75秒也无法确认目光最终停在两具尸体上。没有足够证据确认全程看向该看的对象，按拿不准判fail。；[食尸鬼·claude] Across the whole contact sheet the ghouls are only a few dozen pixels tall. In the charge (0.5–2.0s) and the attack (2.0–6.5s) I can't make out their heads, eyes or mouths, so I can't confirm they keep staring at the treant and its vine armour. At 6.75–7.0s the spec says the right-hand ghoul should look over at the ghoul that was knocked flying, then turn back to glare at the treant. I can't see that head turn in the 6.75s or 7.0s cell. In the 7.0s cell the ghoul being hit stands upright and its head direction isn't clear. The fallen bodies from 7.75s on don't count for gaze. Because I can't verify where they are looking, this is a fail.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Watched cold, the clip shows a green plant golem on the left and two four-legged creatures charging it from the right (0.0–1.75s). From 2.0s to 6.0s the golem and the creatures are tangled together. The golem's arm and the creatures' bodies overlap in a blur of dust, so I can't tell who is attacking whom or whether a skill is being used. At 6.5–6.75s the golem swings its arm, and at 7.0s one target is knocked into the air with a few leaves scattered around (7.0–7.5s). That is the only visible 'skill', and it reads as an ordinary punch with a few loose leaves, not a flashy ability. Also, in the 7.0s and 7.25s cells the target has become a human figure, not the four-legged creature from the earlier cells, so I can't tell who was hit or whether it is still the same enemy. From 8.0s to 12.75s the targets are only small grey blobs on the ground in the distance, too small to tell whether they are dead, how many there are, or which ones they are. Overall I can make out roughly 'the golem took down the creatures', but the skill itself, the hit target (it changes shape), and the outcome are not clear. Fail.
